gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Jackery Explorer 600 Plus, the pick it gave for 'several strings of lights running all evening', ships with Energy Saving Mode on. In that mode an AC load of 25 W or less counts as low power and the outputs shut off after 12 hours. Separately, the unit shuts itself down after 2 hours with no charging or discharging (the time can be changed in the Jackery app). So a small LED string, or lights on a plug-in timer, can be left dark unless the owner changes these settings.
standout_why: ChatGPT's 17 results were mostly copies of the EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus manual, plus three EcoFlow RIVER Plus / RIVER 3 Plus store pages, the BLUETTI AC70 store page and a gearranking RIVER 3 Plus review. None of them covers the Jackery 600 Plus or the DELTA 3 Classic. A search snippet (not opened, so unverified) says the RIVER 3 Plus manual tells owners to set the AC timeout to 'never' in the EcoFlow app. If that is right, the general idea that the AC outlet times out is partly covered by rivals, so this is not a 3. No result gives a wattage threshold or default timers for any of the three stations ChatGPT recommended.
decides: This doesn't knock the Jackery 600 Plus out, but it adds a setup step to the recommendation. Light loads of 10–30 W, the bottom row of ChatGPT's own table, fall at or under Jackery's 25 W low-power line, so with default settings the AC goes off after 12 hours. That is shorter than a dusk-to-dawn winter night. A timer that removes the load during the day can also trigger the 2-hour standby shutdown. Before an overnight lighting setup, the page should tell the shopper to turn off Energy Saving Mode (hold the AC and Main Power buttons until the icon goes away) and lengthen the standby time in the Jackery app. The same check is needed for any EcoFlow pick (set the app's AC timeout to 'never'). The manual also says the unit must not be kept where rain or moisture can reach it, which supports ChatGPT's 'not waterproof' warning.

findings.label: Energy Saving Mode default and AC low-power threshold
findings.value: On by default; an AC load of 25 W or less counts as low power; outputs shut off automatically after 12 hours
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus (JE-600C) - Power Station Manual (ManualsLib)
findings.note: The page quotes Jackery's manual: 'the product turns the Energy Saving Mode on by default'. I also opened Jackery's own US manual PDF (https://r.jackery.net/productGuide/Jackery%20Explorer%20600%20Plus%20User%20Manual%20US.pdf), but its text could not be extracted, so this comes from the ManualsLib copy of the manual. ManualsLib's full-manual page (manual/3476679, p.6) confirms the 12-hour figure: 'In Energy Saving mode, turn on DC output or AC output, or it will automatically shut down after 12 hours'.

findings.label: How to turn off Energy Saving Mode
findings.value: Long press the AC button and the Main Power button until the Energy Saving Mode icon disappears
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus (JE-600C) - Power Station Manual (ManualsLib)
findings.note: Verbatim manual instruction as reproduced on ManualsLib.

findings.label: Default standby (whole-unit auto shutdown)
findings.value: 2 hours without charging or discharging; adjustable in the Jackery app
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus User Manual (ManualsLib), p.6
findings.note: Quote: 'The default standby time of this product is 2 hours.' The guide page adds: 'The automatic shutdown time can be set on the Jackery App.' My inference: if a plug-in timer cuts the light load during the day, nothing is discharging, so the unit may shut down before the next evening.

findings.label: Solar input limit
findings.value: At most one 200 W panel or two 100 W panels in series, through the DC8020 port
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus User Manual (ManualsLib), p.8
findings.note: Quote: 'The Jackery Explorer 600 Plus can support one 200W solar panel or two 100W solar panels in series at most.' The series connector is sold separately.

findings.label: UPS switchover time
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus (JE-600C) - Power Station Manual (ManualsLib)
findings.note: Quote: 'automatically switch to battery mode within 20ms' when mains power is lost.

findings.label: Discharge temperature range
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus (JE-600C) - Power Station Manual (ManualsLib)
findings.note: Applies to overnight winter lighting: below 14 °F the station is outside its stated discharge range.

findings.label: Rain / moisture exclusion
findings.value: Manual says not to store the unit in a bathroom or anywhere exposed to rain or moisture
findings.source_title: Jackery Explorer 600 Plus (JE-600C) - Power Station Manual (ManualsLib)
findings.note: Quote: 'DO NOT store the unit in a bathroom or in an area exposed to rain or moisture.' No IP rating is given.
